Now that he cannot track you, find and destroy [[the Hunter]] and his pack.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find The Hunter within the [[Domain of Secrets]].
* Defeat the Hunter. Be mindful of the Pack that guards him.
* See Keeper Kauniss for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]]

==Walkthrough==
The party will need to explore the Domain of Secrets to find the Hunter.  Note that in addition to the usual [[mob]]s, there will also be [[Shiro'ken Assassin]]s wandering around as well.  The Hunter himself will be accompanied by 3 Shiro'ken Assassins, whom you must kill in order to complete the quest.

==NPCs==
===Foes===

Shiro'ken

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Keeper Kauniss
:''"It is time to strike. Your trail is now lost to him. Find the '''Hunter. Defeat''' him. Although the power imbued upon him by the [[Undead Lich|Lich]] will resurrect his body, he will be unable to track you. Go."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Let's end this.
|decline = I'm not ready yet.
|ask = Somewhere in the '''Domain of Secrets''' you will find the '''Hunter'''. Find him and defeat him. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Keeper Kauniss
:''"Ah, yes. I can sense it. You are free of the Hunter. I can still feel his presence, but I now detect....confusion....frustration....and anger in him. We have succeeded. The Pack roams, scouring for you, but their vision is shrouded in fog. You are free of the Hunter."''

==Notes==
*This quest combines well with the quest [[Blueprint of the Fall]]
*When zoning from the [[Domain of Secrets]], you can move into the clearing directly to your south to quickly check for [[The Hunter]] in the first spawn point.
